faq.title: Answers to the most common questions
faq.subtitle: Learn the details of the platform, integration, and plans before you start.

items.question: Do I need to change my current accounting software?
items.answer: No. You can keep using your software and connect it through our API, or use our dashboard directly as a standalone invoicing app.

items.question: How do you guarantee compliance with ZATCA?
items.answer: The platform is designed and built to the technical and regulatory standards of Phase 2 e-invoicing — we generate digital signatures and codes and submit invoices to ZATCA seamlessly.

items.question: What does “number of taxable persons” mean?
items.answer: A taxable person is a company or entity with its own independent tax number. Starter covers a single entity, while Growth lets you manage up to 5 different entities from one account.

items.question: What if I exceed my monthly invoice limit?
items.answer: You can upgrade to a higher plan at any time, or buy additional invoice bundles at fair prices without any service interruption.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: Yes. Create an account and try the platform in a sandbox environment for free to make sure it's a good fit before you subscribe.
